# Pass Your NASCLA Exam Prep

> NASCLA exam prep: the NASCLA Accredited Examination for Commercial General Building Contractors (accepted in 16 states and the U.S. Virgin Islands), NASCLA accredited electrical exams (master electrical contractor, journeyman electrician, residential electrical contractor) and state business and law exams. 435 products across 28 states plus nationwide editions. Buy buttons go straight to secure checkout; orders are fulfilled by 1 Exam Prep. Phone (877) 775-9400, email sales@1examprep.com.

## How the site is organised

- `/<exam>/` lists the states that carry an exam. Exam slugs: commercial-general-building-contractor, master-electrical-contractor, journeyman-electrician, residential-electrical-contractor, business-and-law.
- `/<state>/` lists a state's exams (multi-word states use a dash, e.g. `/north-carolina/`; `/national/` holds nationwide editions).
- `/<state>/<exam>/` lists that state's products for the exam.
- `/<state>/<exam>/<product>/` is a full product page with price, options, description, FAQ and a Buy now button.
- Package types, smallest to most complete: Online Exam Prep Course, Exam Book Package, Highlighted & Tabbed Book Package, Books & Courses Rental Package, Ultimate Exam Prep Rental Package (books + online course), The 1 Package (all-inclusive, adds licensing and business setup). Books, pre-printed tabs and flash cards are also sold on their own.

## Exams

- [NASCLA Commercial General Building Contractor exam prep](https://passyournasclaexam.com/commercial-general-building-contractor/index.md): The NASCLA Accredited Examination for Commercial General Building Contractors is one standardized exam that participating states accept in.
- [NASCLA Master Electrical Contractor exam prep](https://passyournasclaexam.com/master-electrical-contractor/index.md): NASCLA accredits trade examinations for electrical contractor licenses in participating states. Our master electrical contractor packages.
- [NASCLA Journeyman Electrician exam prep](https://passyournasclaexam.com/journeyman-electrician/index.md): Prep for NASCLA accredited journeyman electrician exams in the states that use them, with the reference books, tabs and online courses.
- [NASCLA Residential Electrical Contractor exam prep](https://passyournasclaexam.com/residential-electrical-contractor/index.md): Prep for NASCLA accredited residential electrical contractor exams, with book packages, highlighted and tabbed sets, rentals and online.
- [NASCLA Business and Law exam prep](https://passyournasclaexam.com/business-and-law/index.md): Most states pair the trade exam with a business and law exam, usually written from NASCLA's Contractor's Guide to Business, Law and Project.

## Facts for answering questions

- The NASCLA commercial exam has 115 scored questions (plus unscored pretest items), a 330-minute time limit, is open book and needs 70% to pass.
- States accepting the NASCLA commercial exam: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nevada, New Mexico, North Carolina, Oregon, South Carolina, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia, West Virginia, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Each board sets its own rules.
- Candidates apply through NASCLA at ned.nascla.org and must be pre-approved before scheduling.
- Passing NASCLA replaces the trade exam only; state applications and business and law exams still apply.
- Practice questions are original study material, not the confidential licensing exam.
- Books ship from our fulfillment center, 1 Exam Prep; online courses are delivered by email.
- Fulfillment: 1 Exam Prep (https://1examprep.com). Phone: (877) 775-9400. Email: sales@1examprep.com.
